**What I learned:**

I learnt about the lead and lag of time series data with the lag being we record the measure today as yesterdays and the lead being we record today measure as tomorrows measure. I also learnt about strict stationarity and weak stationarity and how the aim is to get the model to stationary to be able to then model and make inference, so we difference to remove trends, seasonality. I also learnt about ergodicity which means that the time series fluctuates around a mean value, which indicates stationarity which is the goal. If the data is stationary then we can model, forecast correctly and so on. Lastly the lecture went through how to get the data to be stationary and how to determine how much differencing is required to remove trend in the data.
